user.title: Intelleta
user.description: Paste the key from the Intelleta app (Account → Integration keys → Mint a key). A key is shown once. If you did not copy it, mint another.

reauth_confirm.title: Intelleta
reauth_confirm.description: Your key is no longer accepted. Mint a new one in the Intelleta app (Account → Integration keys → Mint a key) and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The key was not accepted. Paste the whole key again, or mint a new one in the Intelleta app (Account → Integration keys → Mint a key).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Intelleta. Check your internet connection and try again in a moment. Your key is probably fine.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the detail.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
